title: Normalized maps from completed integral coefficients to finite constant quotients are unique
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integer ring and chosen uniformizer as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $T$. Let $I$ be an ideal of the integer ring containing a positive power of the uniformizer. Let $R_I$ be the constant ring sheaf with value $\mathcal O_E/I$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $c$ for the constant-to-completed map into $\mathcal O_{E,T}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and $q_I$ for constant sheafification of reduction modulo $I$. If ring-sheaf maps $f,g:\mathcal O_{E,T}\to R_I$ satisfy $c f=q_I=c g$, then $f=g$.

proof.text: Constant sheafification commutes with the underlying-set functor. A set-theoretic section of the quotient map therefore gives surjectivity of every finite constant quotient map on sections. Subtract a lift of the finite projection of x; the difference has zero projection. Apply lem-sp-completed-integral-projection-divisibility to write x=c(a)+c(pi)^(k+1)y.

Choose k with (pi)^(k+1) contained in I. Naturality of the sheafification unit and the quotient-ring zero criterion show that the normalized map f kills c(pi)^(k+1). Scalar normalization makes f and g agree on c(a) and c(pi). Apply both ring maps to the approximation formula; the divisible terms vanish. Extensionality on sections proves f=g.

proof_origin: Complete Stage 3 Lean proof by sectionwise quotient surjectivity, proved kernel divisibility, scalar normalization and ring-map extensionality.

theorem completedIntegralFiniteQuotientHom_ext
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (T : Scheme.{t})
    (I : Ideal (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hI : ∃ k : ℕ, Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E (k + 1) ≤ I) :
    let F := constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} ⋙
      sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    let R := CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ I))
    let q := F.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom.comp
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I).comp ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom)))
    ∀ f g : WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T ⟶ F.obj R,
      WeilConjectures.integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T ≫ f = q →
      WeilConjectures.integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T ≫ g = q → f = g
